BWA.note: The post mentions an Open Data Policy to be overseen by a Digital Services Authority not yet set up, but does not say whether it is adopted or drafted.

systems.system: Open Data Portal for researchers and innovators

BWA.note: The open data portal is only to be established with Finnish support and no published data is stated.
The post states no startup law, strategy or fund.

facts.fact: The Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub says it convened a workshop of academia, research and private-sector stakeholders around 9 December 2025 on an open data hackathon; no incubation programme or cohort is stated.
